result.summary: The page appears visually clean and well-structured overall. There is one minor layout issue where the 'Popular right now' card image seems slightly cropped at the bottom, and a minor content issue with a partially visible restaurant name in the horizontal scroll section.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section shows a card (pizza image) that is cut off at the bottom of the screen, making it look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card is fully visible or provide a clear visual cue that there is more content below by showing a larger portion of the next card.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll, the third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated.
issues.suggestion: While truncation is common in horizontal scrolls, ensure the full name is accessible on tap or consider adjusting the card width to show more text.
